b1938.description: JVAS B1938+666 (z_l = 0.881, z_s = 2.059): JWST GO 8281 (PI Vegetti), NIRCam F115W + F277W, one visit, modules A and B, 21 exposures per detector (~24.4 h total per filter). Exclusive access ended 2026-10-01.

spt.description: The two SPT lenses of Lange et al. 2025 (SPT_rerun): JWST GO 1355 TEMPLATES (PI Rigby), NIRCam module B only. SPT0418-47 has F115W F150W F200W + F277W F356W F444W; SPT2147-50 has F200W + F277W F356W F444W. Both also have MIRI imaging (F560W..F2100W) and NIRSpec/MIRI IFU in the same program, deliberately not reduced here (NIRCam only).
